title: First research confirmation

bodyBlocks.text: R1 is the research file for an opening that begins beneath an intact surface. Your first destination is now confirmed; no envelope or physical prop is waiting there.

Berea Falls Scenic Overlook: the operator’s directions target 41.378044, -81.866079, and its trailhead listing describes a small visitor lot. Use the normal visitor approach near Barrett Road and Valley Parkway, not railway land or a roadside shoulder. These are destination coordinates, not a surveyed parking bay.
